730:t_1:84.en:
$n
「If I lose, I'll be putting Miss $$スズネ$$ in danger.」

730:t_1:85.en:
$n
「So let's win no matter what - the two of us.」

730:t_1:87.en:
$$ランド$$
(Just you wait, $$アサキム$$. We've got no more doubts.)

730:t_1:88.en:
$$セツコ$$
(I'll end it. Every last tie between you and me.)

730:t_2:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I can't sense any sign of living things here...」

730:t_2:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's not just that there are no animals, so to speak... I can't believe there are even plants or microbes.」

730:t_2:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「Your instinct is right, Captain. I ran a quick check of the air and soil, and I couldn't find even bacteria.」

730:t_2:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's not all... The will of matter we learned about when we achieved $$真化融合$$ - I can't feel any of that, either.」

730:t_2:8.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「Do you mean the planet's $$次元力$$ was used up and it died out, like $$インサラウム$$?」

730:t_2:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「Rather, I think this place was remade into that kind of planet by the $$御使い$$s.」

730:t_2:11.en:
$$刹那$$
「...They said that when they were reborn as higher-dimensional life forms, all life fused together...」

730:t_2:12.en:
$$タケル$$
「The 'all life' they meant seems to include animals, plants, microbes... even matter.」

730:t_2:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「And after all life became one, this place turned into a planet without life, I take it.」

730:t_2:14.en:
$$勝平$$
「Man, I thought the truth of the universe would be a lot more fun than this. Seeing this planet, I sure don't think so.」

730:t_2:15.en:
$$アルト$$
「Same here. Their fusion feels like they forced life together by sheer violence.」

730:t_2:17.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Thinking about it that way, those stones all around us... they look just like graves...」

730:t_3:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Life is formation, abiding, decay, and emptiness... and within that endless cycle, it seems I got too deeply involved with the likes of you...」

730:t_3:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I suppose that loving you all meant I was always going to end up like this.」

730:t_3:8.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I won't apologize, $$セツコ$$. I only fought for my own sake.」

730:t_3:9.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I know. But I will not forgive you.」

730:t_3:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's fine, $$セツコ$$. I'll make sure this guy answers for it.」

730:t_3:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Admitting you lost means you'll lend us a hand, right?」

730:t_3:12.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Only to defeat the $$御使い$$s, mind you.」

730:t_3:13.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Understood, $$アサキム$$... I'll put off our reckoning until then.」

730:t_3:15.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$... You knew the meaning of life after all.」

730:t_3:17.en:
$$アサキム$$
「What could you possibly want now, $$サクリファイ$$?」

730:t_3:18.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「I came to apologize to you.」

730:t_3:19.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Not to heal the sorrow within myself, but to make amends, even in some small way, for what I did to you. That is why I want to apologize.」

730:t_3:20.en:
$$クロウ$$
「An $$御使い$$... is bowing her head...?」

730:t_3:22.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「In your battle with $$アサキム$$, I remembered the meaning of finite life, and its beauty.」

730:t_3:23.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「It is something precious that we threw away 120 million years ago.」

730:t_3:25.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「I admit it. I... regret becoming an $$御使い$$.」

730:t_3:26.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Humans cannot become gods... We were never worthy of taking hold of eternity...」

730:t_4:4.en:
$$イザベル$$
「...To everyone around the world. The resolution under the New $$地球連邦$$ Government's new system will begin shortly.」

730:t_4:5.en:
$$イザベル$$
「This is an important resolution that will decide the future course of the world... the future of humanity. Please watch this broadcast with all due care.」

730:t_4:6.en:
$$グエン$$
「...That is everything I obtained about our enemy from the $$キング$$, the supreme authority of $$クロノ$$.」

730:t_4:11.en:
$$大統領$$
「To all of you listening to my voice... This matter has been drafted as the very first top-priority item of deliberation for the New $$地球連邦$$ Government.」

730:t_4:12.en:
$$大統領$$
「A system that uses the $$レイライン$$ and $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ to incorporate the opinions of every person taking part in the deliberation... We now find ourselves compelled to use it.」

730:t_4:13.en:
$$大統領$$
「Now then, we will take the vote. Referring to the information from Lord $$グエン$$ and the $$サイデリアル$$ as well, please decide yes or no by your own will.」

730:t_4:14.en:
$$大統領$$
「Thanks to the GN particles and $$レイライン$$ covering the entire $$地球圏$$, your will is reflected in the resolution instantly.」

730:t_4:15.en:
$$アーミア$$
「The system that tallies the participants' $$脳量子波$$ is also running with no problems.」

730:t_4:16.en:
$$大統領$$
「Then we will take the vote in 30 seconds. Everyone, please prepare.」

730:t_4:24.en:
$$アーミア$$
「All systems operating normally. The tally results are coming in.」

730:t_4:25.en:
$$大統領$$
「...By an overwhelming majority, this motion is passed.」

730:t_4:26.en:
$$大統領$$
「With this, as soon as the deployment of each unit is complete, the Earth Defense Dimensional Barrier '$$スヴェル$$' will be lifted.」

730:t_10:4.en:
$$ランド$$
(Now that we've come this far, we won't waver... We won't let them have their way with you any longer.)

730:t_10:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
(To settle things between us, too, we will rescue you from the $$御使い$$s.)

730:t_10:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Now that their resolve is firm, all that's left is to do it.」

730:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It seems $$セツコ$$ and $$ランド$$ each sorted out their feelings by fighting $$アサキム$$.」

730:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The result is 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

730:t_10:11.en:
$$エスター$$
「Is he going to be all right...?」

730:t_10:12.en:
$$メール$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ is there with him, but...」

730:t_10:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No need to worry. The guy's tenacity is world-class.」
